translations.web: There were windows in it and in its arches all around, like those windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the width twenty-five cubits.
translations.bsb: Both the gateway and its portico had windows all around, like the other windows. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
translations.kjv: And there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about, like those windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
